key.name: animate-type
key.description: Selects the animation used while tiling (0 = None, 1 = Filled Outline, 2 = Slide, 3 = Zoom, 4 = Drop From Top, 5 = Fade)

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Duration (in ms) of the tiling animation (100 - 2000)

key.name: tile-toggle-type
key.description: Choose the tiling type you want when using toggle. (0 = Tile, 1 = Left, 2 = Tile Vertically, 3 = Tile Horizontally, 4 = Cascade)

key.name: tile-join
key.description: Tries to join the windows together when horizontal, vertical or left tiling is enabled so that when you resize a window surrounding windows resize accordingly. This may cause problems if you dont leave them enough space.

key.name: tile-delta
key.description: Distance between windows when using cascade (0 - 250)

key.name: tile-left-occupancy
key.description: Occupancy percentage for window placed left. This number is percentage of screen width, which the active window will have it as width when tiled. Applies to Left tiling type. (20 - 80)

key.name: exclude-match
key.description: Windows which should be excluded from tiling (match)

key.name: tile-vertically-key
key.description: Move and resize all visible windows so that they have full height, same width and occupy whole screen.

key.name: tile-horizontally-key
key.description: Move and resize all visible windows so that they have full width, same height and occupy whole screen.

key.name: tile-tile-key
key.description: Move and resize all visible windows both vertically and horizontally, so that the occupy whole screen and are in a grid.

key.name: tile-cascade-key
key.description: Move and resize all visible windows with the delta value set for cascading.

key.name: tile-restore-key
key.description: Restore windows to their original position they had before tiling.
